attributes.name: valueUninterruptedServiceP
attributes.documentation: Value of uninterrupted service (Cost per active power).

attributes.name: voltImbalanceViolCost
attributes.documentation: Voltage imbalance violation cost (Cost per unit Voltage).

attributes.name: voltLimitViolCost
attributes.documentation: Voltage limit violation cost (Cost per unit Voltage).

classes.name: ServiceGuarantee
classes.documentation:
A service guarantee, often imposed by a regulator, defines conditions that, if not satisfied, will result in the utility making a monetary payment to the customer. Note that guarantee's identifier is in the 'name' attribute and the status of the guarantee is in the 'Status.status' attribute.
Example service requirements include:
1) If power is not restored within 24 hours, customers can claim $50 for residential customers or $100 for commercial and industrial customers. In addition for each extra period of 12 hours the customer's supply has not been activated, the customer can claim $25.
2) If a customer has a question about their electricity bill, the utility will investigate and respond to the inquiry within 15 working days. If utility fails to meet its guarantee, utility will automatically pay the customer $50.

attributes.name: applicationPeriod
attributes.documentation: Period in which this service guantee applies.

attributes.name: automaticPay
attributes.documentation: True if utility must autmatically pay the specified amount whenever the condition is not satisified, otherwise customer must make a claim to receive payment.

attributes.name: payAmount
attributes.documentation: Amount to be paid by the service provider to the customer for each violation of the 'serviceRequirement'.

attributes.name: serviceRequirement
attributes.documentation: Explanation of the requirement and conditions for satisfying it.

classes.name: StandardIndustryCode
classes.documentation:
The Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) are the codes that identify the type of products/service an industry is involved in, and used for statutory reporting purposes. For example, in the USA these codes are located by the federal government, and then published in a book entitled "The Standard Industrial Classification Manual". The codes are arranged in a hierarchical structure.
Note that Residential Service Agreements are not classified according to the SIC codes.

attributes.name: code
attributes.documentation: Standard alphanumeric code assigned to a particular product/service within an industry.

classes.name: SubscribePowerCurve
classes.documentation: Price curve for specifying the cost of energy (X) at points in time (y1) according to a prcing structure, which is based on a tariff.

classes.name: WorkBillingInfo
classes.documentation: Billing information for work performed for the customer. The history of Work Billing Info, Invoices, and Payments is to be maintained in associated ActivityRecords.

attributes.name: costEstimate
attributes.documentation: Estimated cost for work.

attributes.name: deposit
attributes.documentation: Amount of price on deposit.

attributes.name: discount
attributes.documentation: Discount from standard price.

attributes.name: dueDateTime
attributes.documentation: Date and time by which payment for bill is expected from client.

attributes.name: issueDateTime
attributes.documentation: Date and time bill was issued to client.

attributes.name: receivedDateTime
attributes.documentation: Date payment was received from client.

attributes.name: workPrice
attributes.documentation: Amount of bill.

subPackages.name: InfERPSupport
subPackages.documentation:
The package contains portions of the model defined byEnterprise Resource Planning (ERP) standards like those proposed by the Open Applications Group (OAG). It is provided to facilitate integration among electric utility applications (CIM) and enterprise resource planning (ERP) applications (as defined by OAG). Rather than inventing new CIM classes that accomplish similar functionality as in existing ERP models, the preferred approach is to use and extend ERP classes as appropriate in other packages.
If a model other that the OAG standard is used as a basis for ERP integration, the utility classes labeld "Erp..." should be associated with the appropriate classes of that standard. In fact, definitions of "Erp..." classes are based on OAG Nouns to facilitate this process.

Rather than inventing new CIM classes that accomplish similar functionality as in existing ERP models, the preferred approach is to use and extend ERP classes as appropriate in other packages.
If a model other that the OAG standard is used as a basis for ERP integration, the utility classes labeled "Erp..." should be associated with the appropriate classes of that standard".

classes.name: BillMediaKind
classes.documentation: Kind of bill media.

classes.name: ErpAccountKind
classes.documentation: Kind of ERP account.

classes.name: ErpBOM
classes.documentation:
Information that generally describes the Bill of Material Structure and its contents for a utility.

This is used by ERP systems to transfer Bill of Material information between two business applications.

classes.name: ErpBankAccount
classes.documentation:
Relationship under a particular name, usually evidenced by a deposit against which withdrawals can be made. Types of bank accounts include: demand, time, custodial, joint, trustee, corporate, special, and regular accounts.
A statement of transactions during a fiscal period and the resulting balance is maintained on each account.
For Payment metering, the account is associated with Bank and Supplier, reflecting details of the bank account used for depositing revenue collected by TokenVendor. The name of the account holder should be specified in 'name' attribute.

attributes.name: bankABA
attributes.documentation: Bank ABA.

classes.name: ErpBomItemData
classes.documentation: An individual item on a bill of materials.

classes.name: ErpChartOfAccounts
classes.documentation: Accounting structure of a business. Each account represents a financial aspect of a business, such as its Accounts Payable, or the value of its inventory, or its office supply expenses.

classes.name: ErpCompetency
classes.documentation: Information that describes aptitudes of a utility employee. Unlike Skills that an ErpPerson must be certified to perform before undertaking certain type of assignments (to be able to perfrom a Craft), ErpCompetency has more to do with typical Human Resource (HR) matters such as schooling, training, etc.

classes.name: ErpDocument
classes.documentation: Shadow class for Document, to isolate subclassing from this package. If any subclass gets normative and needs inheritance, it will inherit directly from Document.

classes.name: ErpEngChangeOrder
classes.documentation: General Utility Engineering Change Order information.

classes.name: ErpIdentifiedObject
classes.documentation: Shadow class for IdentifiedObject, to isolate subclassing from this package. If any subclass gets normative and needs inheritance, it will inherit directly from IdentifiedObject.

classes.name: ErpInventory
classes.documentation: Utility inventory-related information about an item or part (and not for description of the item and its attributes). It is used by ERP applications to enable the synchronization of Inventory data that exists on separate Item Master databases. This data is not the master data that describes the attributes of the item such as dimensions, weight, or unit of measure - it describes the item as it exists at a specific location.

classes.name: ErpInventoryCount
classes.documentation:
This is related to Inventory physical counts organized by AssetModel. Note that a count of a type of asset can be accomplished by the association inherited by AssetModel (from Document) to Asset.
It enables ERP applications to transfer an inventory count between ERP and the actual physical inventory location. This count may be a cycle count or a physical count.

classes.name: ErpInvoice
classes.documentation: A roll up of invoice line items. The whole invoice has a due date and amount to be paid, with information such as customer, banks etc. being obtained through associations. The invoice roll up is based on individual line items that each contain amounts and descriptions for specific services or products.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.documentation: Total amount due on this invoice based on line items and applicable adjustments.

attributes.name: billMediaKind
attributes.documentation: Kind of media by which the CustomerBillingInfo was delivered.

attributes.name: dueDate
attributes.documentation: Calculated date upon which the Invoice amount is due.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.documentation: Kind of invoice (default is 'sales').

attributes.name: mailedDate
attributes.documentation: Date on which the customer billing statement/invoice was printed/mailed.

attributes.name: proForma
attributes.documentation: True if payment is to be paid by a Customer to accept a particular ErpQuote (with associated Design) and have work initiated, at which time an associated ErpInvoice should automatically be generated. EprPayment.subjectStatus satisfies terms specificed in the ErpQuote.

attributes.name: referenceNumber
attributes.documentation: Number of an invoice to be reference by this invoice.

attributes.name: transactionDateTime
attributes.documentation: Date and time when the invoice is issued.

attributes.name: transferType
attributes.documentation: Type of invoice transfer.

classes.name: ErpInvoiceKind
classes.documentation: Kind of ERP invoice.

classes.name: ErpInvoiceLineItem
classes.documentation: An individual line item on an invoice.

attributes.name: billPeriod
attributes.documentation: Bill period for the line item.

attributes.name: glAccount
attributes.documentation: General Ledger account code, must be a valid combination.

attributes.name: glDateTime
attributes.documentation: Date and time line item will be posted to the General Ledger.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.documentation: Kind of line item.

attributes.name: lineAmount
attributes.documentation: Amount due for this line item.

attributes.name: lineNumber
attributes.documentation: Line item number on invoice statement.

attributes.name: lineVersion
attributes.documentation: Version number of the bill run.

attributes.name: netAmount
attributes.documentation: Net line item charge amount.

attributes.name: previousAmount
attributes.documentation: Previous line item charge amount.

classes.name: ErpInvoiceLineItemKind
classes.documentation: Kind of invoice line item.

classes.name: ErpIssueInventory
classes.documentation: Can be used to request an application to process an issue or request information about an issue.

classes.name: ErpItemMaster
classes.documentation:
Any unique purchased part for manufactured product tracked by ERP systems for a utility.
Item, as used by the OAG, refers to the basic information about an item, including its attributes, cost, and locations. It does not include item quantities. Compare to the Inventory, which includes all quantities and other location-specific information.

classes.name: ErpJournal
classes.documentation:
Book for recording accounting transactions as they occur. Transactions and adjustments are first recorded in a journal, which is like a diary of instructions, advising which account to be charged and by how much.
A journal represents a change in the balances of a business's financial accounts. Many tasks or transactions throughout an enterprise will result in the creation of a journal. Some examples are creating a customer invoice, paying a vendor, transferring inventory, or paying employees.

classes.name: ErpJournalEntry
classes.documentation: Details of an individual entry in a journal, which is to be posted to a ledger on the posting date.

attributes.name: accountID
attributes.documentation: Account identifier for this entry.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.documentation: The amount of the debit or credit for this account.

attributes.name: postingDateTime
attributes.documentation: Date and time this entry is to be posted to the ledger.

attributes.name: sourceID
attributes.documentation: The identifer of the source for this entry.

attributes.name: transactionDateTime
attributes.documentation: Date and time journal entry was recorded.

classes.name: ErpLedBudLineItem
classes.documentation: Individual entry of a given Ledger Budget, typically containing information such as amount, accounting date, accounting period, and is associated with the applicable general ledger account.

classes.name: ErpLedger
classes.documentation: In accounting transactions, a ledger is a book containing accounts to which debits and credits are posted from journals, where transactions are initially recorded. Journal entries are periodically posted to the ledger. Ledger Actual represents actual amounts by account within ledger within company or business area. Actual amounts may be generated in a source application and then loaded to a specific ledger within the enterprise general ledger or budget application.

classes.name: ErpLedgerBudget
classes.documentation: Information for utility Ledger Budgets. They support the transfer budget amounts between all possible source applications throughout an enterprise and a general ledger or budget application.

classes.name: ErpLedgerEntry
classes.documentation: Details of an individual entry in a ledger, which was posted from a journal on the posted date.

attributes.name: accountID
attributes.documentation: Account identifier for this entry.

attributes.name: accountKind
attributes.documentation: Kind of account for this entry.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.documentation: The amount of the debit or credit for this account.

attributes.name: postedDateTime
attributes.documentation: Date and time this entry was posted to the ledger.

attributes.name: transactionDateTime
attributes.documentation: Date and time journal entry was recorded.

classes.name: ErpPOLineItem
classes.documentation: Of an ErpPurchaseOrder, this is an individually ordered item or product along with the quantity, price and other descriptive information.

classes.name: ErpPayable
classes.documentation: A transaction that represents an invoice from a supplier. A payable (or voucher) is an open item, approved and ready for payment, in the Accounts Payable ledger.

classes.name: ErpPayableLineItem
classes.documentation: Of an ErpPayable, a line item references an ErpInvoiceLineitem or other source such as credit memos.

classes.name: ErpPayment
classes.documentation: Payment infromation and status for any individual line item of an ErpInvoice (e.g., when payment is from a customer). ErpPayable is also updated when payment is to a supplier and ErpReceivable is updated when payment is from a customer. Multiple payments can be made against a single line item and an individual payment can apply to more that one line item.

attributes.name: termsPayment
attributes.documentation: Payment terms (e.g., net 30).

classes.name: ErpPersonnel
classes.documentation: Information that applies to the basic data about a utility person, used by ERP applications to transfer Personnel data for a worker.

classes.name: ErpProjectAccounting
classes.documentation: Utility Project Accounting information, used by ERP applications to enable all relevant sub-systems that submit single sided transactions to transfer information with a Project Accounting Application. This would include, but not necessarily be limited to: Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Budget, Order Management, Purchasing, Time and Labor, Travel and Expense.

classes.name: ErpPurchaseOrder
classes.documentation: A document that communicates an order to purchase goods from a buyer to a supplier. The PurchaseOrder carries information to and from the buyer and supplier. It is a legally binding document once both Parties agree to the contents and the specified terms and conditions of the order.

classes.name: ErpQuote
classes.documentation: Document describing the prices of goods or services provided by a supplier. It includes the terms of the purchase, delivery proposals, identification of goods or services ordered, as well as their quantities.

classes.name: ErpQuoteLineItem
classes.documentation: Of an ErpQuote, the item or product quoted along with quantity, price and other descriptive information.

classes.name: ErpRecDelvLineItem
classes.documentation: Of an ErpReceiveDelivery, this is an individually received good or service by the Organisation receiving goods or services. It may be used to indicate receipt of goods in conjunction with a purchase order line item.

classes.name: ErpRecLineItem
classes.documentation: Individual entry of an ErpReceivable, it is a particular transaction representing an invoice, credit memo or debit memo to a customer.

classes.name: ErpReceivable
classes.documentation: Transaction representing an invoice, credit memo or debit memo to a customer. It is an open (unpaid) item in the Accounts Receivable ledger.

classes.name: ErpReceiveDelivery
classes.documentation: Transaction for an Organisation receiving goods or services that may be used to indicate receipt of goods in conjunction with a purchase order. A receivable is an open (unpaid) item in the Accounts Receivable ledger.

classes.name: ErpReqLineItem
classes.documentation: Information that describes a requested item and its attributes.

attributes.name: cost
attributes.documentation: Cost of material.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.documentation: Quantity of item requisitioned.

classes.name: ErpRequisition
classes.documentation: General information that applies to a utility requisition that is a request for the purchase of goods or services. Typically, a requisition leads to the creation of a purchase order to a specific supplier.

classes.name: ErpSalesOrder
classes.documentation:
General purpose Sales Order is used for utility service orders, etc.
As used by the OAG, the SalesOrder is a step beyond a PurchaseOrder in that the receiving entity of the order also communicates SalesInformoration about the Order along with the Order itself.

classes.name: ErpSiteLevelData
classes.documentation: For a utility, general information that describes physical locations of organizations or the location codes and their meanings. This enables ERP applications to ensure that the physical location identifiers are synchronized between the business applications.

classes.name: ErpTimeEntry
classes.documentation: An individual entry on an ErpTimeSheet.

classes.name: ErpTimeSheet
classes.documentation: Time sheet for employees and contractors. Note that ErpTimeSheet inherits the relationship to ErpPerson from Document.

subPackages.name: DetailedDiagrams
subPackages.documentation: Most of these classes do not need generic status: if required status value, some enums should be defined, or at least a common base class.

subPackages.name: IEC62325
subPackages.documentation: The IEC 62325 subpackages of the CIM are developed, standardized and maintained by the IEC TC57.

classes.name: IEC62325CIMVersion
classes.documentation: IEC 62325 version number assigned to this UML model.

attributes.name: date
attributes.documentation: Form is YYYY-MM-DD for example for January 5, 2009 it is 2009-01-05.

attributes.name: version
attributes.documentation: Form is IEC62325CIMXXvYY where XX is the major CIM package version and the YY is the minor version. For example IEC62325CIM10v03.

subPackages.name: MarketCommon
subPackages.documentation: This package contains the common objects shared by MarketManagement, MarketOperations and Environmental packages.

classes.name: MarketParticipant
classes.documentation: An identification of a party acting in a electricity market business process. This class is used to identify organizations that can participate in market management and/or market operations.

classes.name: MarketRole
classes.documentation: The external intended behavior played by a party within the electricity market.

attributes.name: type
attributes.documentation: The kind of market roles that can be played by parties for given domains within the electricity market. Types are flexible using dataType of string for free-entry of role types.

classes.name: RegisteredResource
classes.documentation: A resource that is registered through the market participant registration system. Examples include generating unit, load, and non-physical generator or load.

attributes.name: ACAFlag
attributes.documentation: Indication that this resource is associated with an Adjacent Control Area.

attributes.name: ASSPOptimizationFlag
attributes.documentation: Indication that the resource participates in the optimization process by default.

attributes.name: commercialOpDate
attributes.documentation: Resource Commercial Operation Date.

attributes.name: contingencyAvailFlag
attributes.documentation: Contingent operating reserve availiability (Yes/No).  Resource is availiable to participate with capacity in contingency dispatch.

attributes.name: dispatchable
attributes.documentation: Dispatchable: indicates whether the resource is dispatchable. This implies that the resource intends to submit Energy bids/offers or Ancillary Services bids/offers, or self-provided schedules.

attributes.name: ECAFlag
attributes.documentation: Indication that this resource is associated with an Embedded Control area.

attributes.name: flexibleOfferFlag
attributes.documentation: Flexible offer flag (Y/N).

attributes.name: hourlyPredispatch
attributes.documentation: Indicates need to dispatch before the start of the operating hour. Only relevant in Real-Time Market. Applies to generation, intertie and participating load resource. Value (Y/N).

attributes.name: isAggregatedRes
attributes.documentation: A flag to indicate if a resource is an aggregated resource.

attributes.name: lastModified
attributes.documentation: Indication of the last time this item was modified/versioned.

attributes.name: LMPMFlag
attributes.documentation: LMPM flag: indicates whether the resource is subject to the LMPM test (Yes/No).

attributes.name: marketParticipationFlag
attributes.documentation: Market Participation flag: indicates whether the resource participate in the market.

attributes.name: maxBaseSelfSchedQty
attributes.documentation: Maximum base self schedule quantity.

attributes.name: maxOnTime
attributes.documentation: Maximum on time after start up.

attributes.name: minDispatchTime
attributes.documentation: Minimum number of consecutive hours a resource shall be dispatched if bid is accepted.

attributes.name: minOffTime
attributes.documentation: Minimum off time after shut down.

attributes.name: minOnTime
attributes.documentation: Minimum on time after start up.

attributes.name: mustOfferFlag
attributes.documentation: Must offer flag: indicates whether the unit is subject to the must offer provisions (Y/N).

attributes.name: nonMarket
attributes.documentation: Flag to indicate that the Resource is not participating in the Market Operations.

attributes.name: pointOfDeliveryFlag
attributes.documentation: Indication that the registered resource is a Point of Delivery (YES) resource which implies there is a POD Loss Factor.

attributes.name: priceSetFlagDA
attributes.documentation:
Price setting flag: indicates whether a resource is capable of setting the Market Clearing Price (Y) for the DA market, and if not, indicates whether the resource shall submit bids for energy at $ 0 (S) or not (N).

Initially in the RegisteredGenerator class. It was moved to the RegisteredResource class for the participating load dispatch purpose.

attributes.name: priceSetFlagRT
attributes.documentation:
Price setting flag: indicates whether a resource is capable of setting the Market Clearing Price (Y) for the RT market, and if not, indicates whether the resource shall submit bids for energy at $ 0 (S) or not (N).

Initially in the RegisteredGenerator class. It was moved to the RegisteredResource class for the participating load dispatch purpose.

attributes.name: registrationStatus
attributes.documentation: Registration Status of resource - Active, Mothballed, Planned, or Decommissioned.

attributes.name: resourceAdequacyFlag
attributes.documentation: Indication that this resource participates in the resource adequacy function.

attributes.name: SMPMFlag
attributes.documentation: SMPM flag: indicates whether the resource is subject to the SMPM test (Yes/No).

classes.name: MktGeneratingUnit
classes.documentation: Subclass of IEC61970:Production:GeneratingUnit.

classes.name: EnvironmentalMonitoringStation
classes.documentation: An environmental monitoring station, examples of which could be a weather station or a seismic monitoring station.

attributes.name: dstObserved
attributes.documentation: Whether this station is currently reporting using daylight saving time.  Intended to aid a utility Weather Service in interpreting information coming from a station and has no direct relationship to the manner in which time is expressed in EnvironmentalValueSet.

attributes.name: isNetworked
attributes.documentation: Indication that station is part of a network of stations used to monitor weather phenomena covering a large geographical area.

attributes.name: timeZoneOffset
attributes.documentation:
The time offset from UTC (a.k.a. GMT) configured in the station "clock", not (necessarily) the time zone in which the station is physically located.
This attribute exists to support management of utility monitoring stations and has no direct relationship to the manner in which time is expressed in EnvironmentalValueSet.

classes.name: ResourceCapacity
classes.documentation: This class model the various capacities of a resource. A resource may have numbers of capacities related to operating, ancillary services, energy trade and so forth. Capacities may be defined for active power or reactive power.

attributes.name: capacityType
attributes.documentation:
capacity type

The types are but not limited to:

Regulation Up
Regulation Dn
Spinning Reserve
Non-Spinning Reserve
FOO capacity
MOO capacity

attributes.name: defaultCapacity
attributes.documentation: default capacity

attributes.name: maximumCapacity
attributes.documentation: maximum capacity

attributes.name: minimumCapacity
attributes.documentation: minimum capacity

attributes.name: unitSymbol
attributes.documentation: Unit selection for the capacity values.

subPackages.name: MarketManagement
subPackages.documentation: This package contains all core CIM Market Extensions required for market management systems.

classes.name: AceTariffType
classes.documentation: The Area Control Error tariff type that is applied or used.

attributes.name: type
attributes.documentation: The coded type of an ACE tariff.

classes.name: AttributeInstanceComponent
classes.documentation: A class used to provide information about an attribute.

attributes.name: attribute
attributes.documentation: The identification of the formal name of an attribute.

attributes.name: attributeValue
attributes.documentation: The instance value of the attribute.

attributes.name: position
attributes.documentation: A sequential value representing a relative sequence number.

classes.name: Auction
classes.documentation: A class providing the identification and type of an auction.

attributes.name: allocationMode
attributes.documentation: Identification of the method of allocation in an auction.

attributes.name: cancelled
attributes.documentation: An indicator that signifies that the auction has been cancelled.

attributes.name: category
attributes.documentation: The product category of an auction.

attributes.name: paymentTerms
attributes.documentation: The terms which dictate the determination of the bid payment price.

attributes.name: rights
attributes.documentation: The rights of use the transmission capacity acquired in an auction.

attributes.name: type
attributes.documentation: The kind of the Auction (e.g. implicit, explicit ...).

classes.name: BidTimeSeries
classes.documentation: The formal specification of specific characteristics related to a bid.

attributes.name: blockBid
attributes.documentation: Indication that  the values in the period are considered as a whole. They cannot be changed or subdivided.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.documentation: The coded identification of the energy flow.

attributes.name: divisible
attributes.documentation: An indication whether or not each element of the bid may be partially accepted or not.

attributes.name: exclusiveBidsIdentification
attributes.documentation:
Unique identification associated with all linked tenders.
The identification of a set of tenders that are linked together signifying that only one can be accepted. 
This identification is defined by the tenderer and must be unique for a given auction.

attributes.name: linkedBidsIdentification
attributes.documentation: Unique identification associated with all linked bids.

attributes.name: minimumActivationQuantity
attributes.documentation: The minimum quantity of energy that can be activated at a given time interval.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.documentation: The numeric local priority given to a bid. Lower numeric values will have higher priority.

attributes.name: status
attributes.documentation: The information about the status of the bid, such as "shared", "restricted", ...

attributes.name: stepIncrementQuantity
attributes.documentation: The minimum increment that can be applied for an increase in an activation request.

classes.name: ConstraintDuration
classes.documentation: Duration constraint to activate, to put in operation, to deactivate, ... a given event.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.documentation: The duration of the constraint.

attributes.name: type
attributes.documentation: The type of the constraint.

classes.name: DateAndOrTime
classes.documentation: The date and/or the time.

attributes.name: date
attributes.documentation: Date as "yyyy-mm-dd", which conforms with ISO 8601

attributes.name: time
attributes.documentation: Time as "hh:mm:ss.sssZ", which conforms with ISO 8601.

classes.name: Domain
classes.documentation: An area of activity defined within the energy market.

classes.name: FlowDirection
classes.documentation: The coded identification of the direction of energy flow.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.documentation: The coded identification of the direction of energy flow.

classes.name: MarketAgreement
classes.documentation: An identification  or eventually the contents of an agreement between two or more parties.

classes.name: MarketDocument
classes.documentation: Electronic document containing the information necessary to satisfy a given business process set of requirements.

classes.name: MarketEvaluationPoint
classes.documentation: The identification of an entity where energy products are measured or computed.

classes.name: MarketObjectStatus
classes.documentation: The condition or position of an object with regard to its standing.

attributes.name: status
attributes.documentation: The coded condition or position of an object with regard to its standing.

classes.name: MktPSRType
classes.documentation: The type of a power system resource.

attributes.name: psrType
attributes.documentation: The coded type of a power system resource.

classes.name: Period
classes.documentation: An identification of a time interval that may have a given resolution.

attributes.name: resolution
attributes.documentation: The number of units of time that compose an individual step within a period.

attributes.name: timeInterval
attributes.documentation: The start and end date and time for a given interval.

classes.name: Point
classes.documentation: An identification of a set of values beeing adressed within a specific interval of time.

attributes.name: position
attributes.documentation: A sequential value representing the relative position within a given time interval.

attributes.name: quality
attributes.documentation: The quality of the information being provided. This quality may be estimated, not available, as provided, etc.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.documentation: Principal quantity identified for a point.

attributes.name: secondaryQuantity
attributes.documentation: Secondary quantity identified for a point.

classes.name: Price
classes.documentation: The cost corresponding to a specific measure and expressed in a currency.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.documentation: A number of monetary units specified in a unit of currency.

attributes.name: category
attributes.documentation: The category of a price to be used in a price calculation. The price category is mutually agreed between System Operators.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.documentation: The direction indicates whether a System Operator pays the Market Parties or inverse.

classes.name: Process
classes.documentation: The formal specification of a set of business transactions having the same business goal.

attributes.name: classificationType
attributes.documentation: The classification mechanism used to group a set of objects together within a business process. The grouping may be of a detailed or a summary nature.

attributes.name: processType
attributes.documentation: The kind of business process.

classes.name: Quantity
classes.documentation:
Description of quantities needed in the data exchange. 
The type of the quantity is described either by the role of the association or the type attribute.
The quality attribute provides the information about the quality of the quantity (measured, estimated, etc.).

attributes.name: quality
attributes.documentation: The quality of the information being provided. This quality may be estimated, not available, as provided, etc.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.documentation:
The quantity value.
The association role provides the information about what is expressed.

attributes.name: type
attributes.documentation: The description of the type of the quantity.

classes.name: Reason
classes.documentation: The motivation of an act.

attributes.name: code
attributes.documentation: The motivation of an act in coded form.

attributes.name: text
attributes.documentation: The textual explanation corresponding to the reason code.

classes.name: Series
classes.documentation: A set of similar physical or conceptual objects defined for the same period or point of time.

attributes.name: lastUpdateDate
attributes.documentation: The date of the last update related to this market object.

attributes.name: methodType
attributes.documentation: Type of method used in the business process related to this Series, e.g. metering method.

attributes.name: registrationDate
attributes.documentation: For a market object, the date of registration of a contract, e.g. the date of change of supplier for a customer.

classes.name: TimeSeries
classes.documentation: A set of regular time-ordered measurements or values of quantitative nature of an individual or collective phenomenon taken at successive, in most cases equidistant, periods / points of time.

attributes.name: businessType
attributes.documentation: The identification of the nature of the time series.

attributes.name: cancelledTS
attributes.documentation: An indicator stating that the TimeSeries, identified by the mRID, is cancelled as well as all the values sent in a previous version of the TimeSeries in a previous document.

attributes.name: curveType
attributes.documentation: The coded representation of the type of curve being described.

subPackages.name: CongestionRevenueRights
subPackages.documentation: Congestion rent is a major, highly volatile charge currently faced by many participants in the LMP-based electrical energy markets. For this reason, the ISOs offer congestion revenue rights (CRR), also known as financial transmission rights or transmission congestion contracts. These are financial instruments that allow market participants to hedge against congestion charges when they schedule their generation, load and bilateral energy transactions.

classes.name: CongestionRevenueRight
classes.documentation:
Congestion Revenue Rights (CRR) class that is inherited from a Document class.

A CRR is a financial concept that is used to hedge congestion charges.

The CRR is usually settled based on the Locational Marginal Prices (LMPs) that are calculated in the day-ahead market. These LMPs are determined by the Day-ahead resource schedules/bids. CRRs will not hedge against marginal losses. If the congestion component of LMP at the sink is greater than at the source, then the CRR owner is entitled to receive a portion of congestion revenues. If the congestion component at the sink is less than at the source, then an obligation-type CRR owner will be charged, but an option-type CRR owner will not.

classes.name: DefaultBid
classes.documentation:
DefaultBid is a generic class to hold Default Energy Bid, Default Startup Bid, and Default Minimum Load Bid: Default Energy Bid A Default Energy Bid is a monotonically increasing staircase function consisting at maximum 10 economic bid segments, or 10 ($/MW, MW) pairs. There are three methods for determining the Default Energy Bid:
  • Cost Based: derived from the Heat Rate or Average Cost multiplied by the Gas Price Index plus 10%.
  • LMP Based: a weighted average of LMPs in the preceding 90 days.
  • Negotiated: an amount negotiated with the designated Independent Entity.
Default Startup Bid A Default Startup Bid (DSUB) shall be calculated for each RMR unit based on the Startup Cost stored in the Master File and the applicable GPI and EPI. Default Minimum Load Bid A Default Minimum Load Bid (DMLB) shall be calculated for each RMR unit based on the Minimum Load Cost stored in the Master File and the applicable GPI.

classes.name: SecurityConstraintSum
classes.documentation:
Typically provided by RTO systems, constraints identified in both base case and critical contingency cases have to be transferred.
A constraint has N (>=1) constraint terms. A term is represented by an instance of TerminalConstraintTerm. 
The constraint expression is:
minValue <= c1*x1 + c2*x2 + .... cn*xn + k <= maxValue
where:
- cn is ConstraintTerm.factor 
- xn is the flow at the terminal
Flow into the associated equipment is positive for the purpose of ConnectivityNode NodeConstraintTerm.

k is SecurityConstraintsLinear.resourceMW.
The units of k are assumed to be same as the units of the flows, xn.  The constants, cn, are dimensionless.
With these conventions, cn and k are all positive for a typical constraint such as "weighted sum of generation shall be less than limit". Furthermore, cn are all 1.0 for a case such as "interface flow shall be less than limit", assuming the terminals are chosen on the importing side of the interface.

For example, a price may be forecasted a year ahead, a month ahead, a day ahead, an hour ahead, and in real time; this is defined using the MarketType. Additionally a price may have one or more components. For example, a locational marginal energy price may be the arithmetic sum of the system price, the congestion price, and the loss price. classes.name: RegisteredLoad
classes.documentation:
Model of a load that is registered to participate in the market.

RegisteredLoad is used to model any load that is served by the wholesale market directly. RegisteredLoads may be dispatchable or non-dispatchable and may or may not have bid curves. Examples of RegisteredLoads would include: distribution company load, energy retailer load, large bulk power system connected facility load.

Loads that are served indirectly, for example - through an energy retailer or a vertical utility, should be modeled as RegisteredDistributedResources. Examples of RegisteredDistributedResources would include: distribution level storage, distribution level generation and distribution level demand response.

attributes.name: siteMultiplier

For example, a response method of air conditioning could utilize a small amount of active power from each air conditioning unit (e.g. 0.1 kiloWatt), but the site multiplier could be used to produce a the total active power adjustment by multiplying the response method active power by this value (e.g. a building with 100 window air conditioning  units, so 100 * 0.1 kW = 10 kW).

classes.name: SchedulingCoordinator
classes.documentation: Market participants could be represented by Scheduling Coordinators (SCs) that are registered with the RTO/ISO. One participant could register multiple SCs with the RTO/ISO. Many market participants can do business with the RTO/ISO using a single SC. One SC could schedule multiple generators. A load scheduling point could be used by multiple SCs. Each SC could schedule load at multiple scheduling points. An inter-tie scheduling point can be used by multiple SCs. Each SC can schedule interchange at multiple inter-tie scheduling points.

classes.name: SchedulingPoint
classes.documentation: Connection to other organizations at the boundary of the ISO/RTO.

classes.name: StartUpEnergyCurve
classes.documentation: The energy consumption of a generating resource to complete a start-up from the StartUpEnergyCurve. Definition of the StartUpEnergyCurve includes, xvalue as the cooling time and y1value as the MW value.

classes.name: StartUpFuelCurve
classes.documentation: The fuel consumption of a Generating Resource to complete a Start-Up.(x=cooling time) Form Startup Fuel Curve. xAxisData -> cooling time, y1AxisData -> MBtu.

classes.name: SubControlArea
classes.documentation: An area defined for the purpose of tracking interchange with surrounding areas via tie points; may or may not serve as a control area.

attributes.name: areaShortName
attributes.documentation: Market area short name, which is the regulation zone. It references AGC regulation zone name.

attributes.name: constantCoefficient
attributes.documentation: Loss estimate constant coefficient

attributes.name: embeddedControlArea
attributes.documentation: Used in conjunction with the InternalCA flag. If the InternalCA flag is YES, this flag does not apply. If the InternaCA flag is NO, this flag provides an indication of AdjacentCA (NO) or Embedded CA (YES).

attributes.name: internalCA
attributes.documentation: A Yes/No indication that this control area is contained internal to the system.

attributes.name: linearCoefficient
attributes.documentation: Loss estimate linear coefficient

attributes.name: localCA
attributes.documentation: Indication that this control area is the local control area.

attributes.name: maxSelfSchedMW
attributes.documentation: Maximum amount of self schedule MWs allowed for an embedded control area.

attributes.name: minSelfSchedMW
attributes.documentation: Minimum amount of self schedule MW allowed for an embedded control area.

attributes.name: quadraticCoefficient
attributes.documentation: Loss estimate quadratic coefficient

classes.name: SubstitutionResourceList
classes.documentation: List of resources that can be substituted for within the bounds of a Contract definition. This class has a precedence and a resource.

attributes.name: precedence
attributes.documentation: An indicator of the order a resource should be substituted. The lower the number the higher the precedence.

classes.name: TACArea
classes.documentation: Transmission Access Charge Area. Charges assessed, on behalf of the Participating Transmission Owner, to parties who require access to the controlled grid.

classes.name: TransmissionRightChain
classes.documentation: Allows chaining of TransmissionContractRights. Many individual contract rights can be included in the definition of a TransmissionRightChain. A TransmissionRightChain is also defined as a TransmissionContractRight itself.

classes.name: WheelingCounterParty
classes.documentation: Counter party in a wheeling transaction.

subPackages.name: DetailedDiagrams
subPackages.documentation:
Note 1: Certain AggregatePnodes do not have an association with a ConnectivityNode. 
Note 2: All Pnodes that are not of type AggregatePnode must have exactly 1 ConnectivityNode.

subPackages.name: Environmental
subPackages.documentation:
NOTES:
  1. Wind speed and direction are handled by two independent analog values.
  2. Astronomical and Tidal event time information (sunset, moon rise, high tide, etc.) are assumed to be outside the scope of CIM Environmental Data modeling.

classes.name: AlertTypeList
classes.documentation:
A named list of alert types.
Note:  the name of the list is reflected in the .name attribute (inherited from IdentifiedObject).

attributes.name: version
attributes.documentation: The version of the named list of alert types.

classes.name: AtmosphericAnalog
classes.documentation: Analog (float) measuring an atmospheric condition.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.documentation: Kind of atmospheric analog.

classes.name: AtmosphericPhenomenon
classes.documentation: An atmospheric phenomenon with a base and altitude providing the vertical coverage (combined with the Location to provide three dimensional space).

attributes.name: altitude
attributes.documentation: The maximum altitude of the phenomenon.

attributes.name: base
attributes.documentation: The base altitude of the phenomenon.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.documentation: The direction the phenomenon is moving.

attributes.name: maxCoverage
attributes.documentation: The maximum percentage coverage

attributes.name: minCoverage
attributes.documentation: The minimum percentage coverage

attributes.name: speed
attributes.documentation: The speed of the phenomenon

classes.name: ClassificationCondition
classes.documentation: A classification condition used to define preconditions that must be met by a phenomena classification.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.documentation: The duration of the of the condition in seconds

attributes.name: test
attributes.documentation: The test applied to the value.

classes.name: CloudCondition
classes.documentation: A classified cloud phenomenon with a type.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.documentation: The type of the cloud as defined by the CloudKind enumeration.

classes.name: Cyclone
classes.documentation: A cyclone (or tropical cyclone), a rapidly-rotating storm system characterized by a low-pressure center, strong winds, and a spiral arrangement of thunderstorms that produce heavy rain.

attributes.name: centralPressure
attributes.documentation: The central pressure of the cyclone during the time interval.

attributes.name: maxSurfaceWindSpeed
attributes.documentation: The maximum surface wind speed of the cyclone during the time interval.

attributes.name: windForce
attributes.documentation: Wind Force as classified on the Beaufort Scale (0-12) during the time interval.

classes.name: Earthquake
classes.documentation: An earthquake.

attributes.name: focalDepth
attributes.documentation: The depth below the earth's surface of the earthquake's focal point.

attributes.name: intensity
attributes.documentation: The intensity of the earthquake as defined by the Modified Mercalli Intensity (MMI) scale. Possible values are 1-12, corresponding to I-XII.

attributes.name: magnitude
attributes.documentation: The magnitude of the earthquake as defined on the Moment Magnitude (M<sub>w</sub>) scale, which measures the size of earthquakes in terms of the energy released. Must be greater than zero.

classes.name: EnvironmentalAnalog
classes.documentation: Analog (float) measurement of relevance in the environmental domain.

classes.name: EnvironmentalAlert
classes.documentation: An environmental alert issued by a provider or system.

attributes.name: alertType
attributes.documentation: The type of the issued alert which is drawn from the specified alert type list.

attributes.name: cancelledDateTime
attributes.documentation: Time and date alert cancelled. Used only if alert is cancelled before it expires.

attributes.name: headline
attributes.documentation:
An abbreviated textual description of the alert issued. 
Note: the full text of the alert appears in the .description attribute (inherited from IdentifiedObject).

attributes.name: inEffect
attributes.documentation: The interval for which this weather alert is in effect.

classes.name: EnvironmentalCodedValue
classes.documentation: An environmental value described using a coded value. A triplicate of enumerated values representing intensity, coverage, type of weather is used. These may be concatenated into the string value.

attributes.name: coverageKind
attributes.documentation: Code representing the coverage of the weather condition.

attributes.name: intensityKind
attributes.documentation: Code representing the intensity of the weather condition.

attributes.name: probabilityPercent
attributes.documentation: Probability of weather condition occurring during the time interval expressed as a percentage. Applicable only when weather condition is related to a forecast (not an observation).

attributes.name: weatherKind
attributes.documentation: Code representing the type of weather condition.

classes.name: EnvironmentalDataAuthority
classes.documentation: An entity defining classifications or categories of environmental information, like phenomena or alerts.

classes.name: EnvironmentalDataProvider
classes.documentation: Entity providing environmental data.  Could be an observed weather data provider, an entity providing forecasts, an authority providing alerts, etc.

classes.name: EnvironmentalDiscrete
classes.documentation: Discrete (integer) measurement of relevance in the environmental domain.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.documentation: Kind of environmental discrete (integer).

classes.name: EnvironmentalEvent
classes.documentation:
An environmental event to which one or more forecasts or observations may be tied and which may relate to or affect one or more assets. This class is intended to be used as a means of grouping forecasts and/or observations and could be used for a variety of purposes, including:
  • to define a 'named' event like Hurricane Katrina and allow the historic (or forecast) values for phenomena and measurements (precipitation, temperature) across time to be associated with it
  • to identify assets that were (or are forecast to be) affected by a phenomenon or set of measurements

classes.name: EnvironmentalInformation
classes.documentation: Abstract class (with concrete child classes of Observation and Forecast) that groups phenomenon and/or environmental value sets.

attributes.name: created
attributes.documentation: The timestamp of when the forecast was created

classes.name: EnvironmentalLocationType
classes.documentation: Type of environmental location. Used when an environmental alert or phenomenon has multiple locations associated with it.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.documentation: The kind of location. Typical values might be center, extent, primary, secondary, etc.

classes.name: EnvironmentalPhenomenon
classes.documentation: The actual or forecast characteristics of an environmental phenomenon at a specific point in time (or during a specific time interval) that may have both a center and area/line location.

attributes.name: timeInterval
attributes.documentation: The timestamp of the phenomenon as a single point or time interval.

classes.name: EnvironmentalStringMeasurement
classes.documentation: String measurement of relevance in the environmental domain.

classes.name: Fire
classes.documentation: A fire, often uncontrolled, covering an area of land which typically contains combustible vegetation. Associated location information is assumed to describe the total area burned as of a specified time.

classes.name: Flood
classes.documentation: A flood, an overflowing of a large amount of water beyond its normal confines, esp. over what is normally dry land.

classes.name: Forecast
classes.documentation: A forecast group of value sets and/or phenomena characteristics.

attributes.name: validFor
attributes.documentation: The interval for which the forecast is valid.  For example, a forecast issued now for tomorrow might be valid for the next 2 hours.

classes.name: GeosphericAnalog
classes.documentation: Analog (float) measuring a geospheric condition.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.documentation: Kind of geospheric analog.

classes.name: GeosphericPhenomenon
classes.documentation: A geospheric phenomenon.

classes.name: Hurricane
classes.documentation: A hurricane, a subtype of cyclone occurring in the North Atlantic Ocean or North-eastern Pacific Ocean whose intensity is measured using the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Scale.

attributes.name: category
attributes.documentation: The hurricane's category during the time interval, using Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Wind Scale, a 1 to 5 rating based on a hurricane's sustained wind speed.

classes.name: HydrosphericAnalog
classes.documentation: Analog (float) measuring a hydrospheric condition.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.documentation: Kind of hydrospheric analog.

classes.name: HydrosphericPhenomenon
classes.documentation: A hydrospheric phenomenon.

classes.name: Landslide
classes.documentation: A landslide, a large mass of rocks and earth that suddenly and quickly moves down the side of a mountain or hill.

classes.name: LightningStrike
classes.documentation: A cloud-to-ground lightning strike at a particular location.

attributes.name: errorEllipseConfidence
attributes.documentation: Likelihood that strike fell within errorEllipse.

attributes.name: errorEllipseMajorSemiAxis
attributes.documentation: Length of major semi-axis (longest radius) of the error ellipse.

attributes.name: errorEllipseMinorSemiAxis
attributes.documentation: Length of minor semi-axis (shortest radius) of the error ellipse.

attributes.name: errorEllipseOrientation
attributes.documentation: The orientation of the major semi- axis in degrees from True North.

attributes.name: negativePolarity
attributes.documentation: The polarity of the strike, with T meaning negative. About 90% of all lightning strokes are negative strokes, meaning that they were initiated by a large concentration of negative charge in the cloud-base; this tends to induce an area of positive charge on the ground.

attributes.name: peakAmplitude
attributes.documentation: Peak current of strike.

classes.name: MagneticStorm
classes.documentation: A magnetic storm, a temporary disturbance of the earth's magnetic field, induced by radiation and streams of charged particles from the sun.

attributes.name: changeDst
attributes.documentation:
Change in the disturbance  - storm time (Dst) index. The size of a geomagnetic storm is classified as:
- moderate ( -50 nT >minimum of Dst > -100 nT)
- intense (-100 nT > minimum Dst > -250 nT) or 
- super-storm ( minimum of Dst < -250 nT).

classes.name: Observation
classes.documentation: Observed (actual non-forecast) values sets and/or phenomena characteristics.

classes.name: PhenomenonClassification
classes.documentation: A pre-defined phenomenon classification as defined by a particular authority.

classes.name: ReportingCapability
classes.documentation: <font color="#0f0f0f">Definition of one set of reporting capabilities for this monitoring station. The associated EnvironmentalValueSets describe the maximum range of possible environmental values the station is capable of returning.  This attribute is intended primarily to assist a utility in managing its stations. </font>

attributes.name: reportingIntervalPeriod
attributes.documentation: Number of units of time making up reporting period.

attributes.name: reportingIntervalType
attributes.documentation: Unit of time in which reporting period is expressed.

attributes.name: reportingMethod
attributes.documentation: Indicates how the weather station reports observations.

classes.name: SpaceAnalog
classes.documentation: Analog (float) measuring a space (extra-terrestrial) condition.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.documentation: Kind of space analog.

classes.name: SpacePhenomenon
classes.documentation: An extra-terrestrial phenomenon.

classes.name: Tornado
classes.documentation: A tornado, a violent destructive whirling wind accompanied by a funnel-shaped cloud that progresses in a narrow path over the land.

attributes.name: fScale
attributes.documentation: Fujita scale (referred to as EF-scale starting in 2007) for the tornado.

attributes.name: width
attributes.documentation: Width of the tornado during the time interval.

classes.name: TropicalCycloneAustralia
classes.documentation: A tropical cyclone, a subtype of cyclone that forms to the east of 90°E in the Southern Hemisphere whose intensity is measured by the Australian tropical cyclone intensity scale.

attributes.name: category
attributes.documentation:
Strength of tropical cyclone during the time interval, based on Australian Bureau of Meteorology Category System where:
1 - tropical cyclone, with typical gusts over flat land 90-125 km/h
2 - tropical cyclone, with typical gusts over flat land 125-164 km/h
3 - severe tropical cyclone, with typical gusts over flat land 165-224 km/h
4 - severe tropical cyclone, with typical gusts over flat land 225-279 km/h
5 - severe tropical cyclone, with typical gusts over flat land greater  than 280 km/h.

classes.name: Tsunami
classes.documentation: A tsunami (tidal wave), a long high sea wave caused by an earthquake, submarine landslide, or other disturbance.

attributes.name: intensity
attributes.documentation: Tsunami intensity on the Papadopoulos-Imamura tsunami intensity scale. Possible values are 1-12, corresponding to I-XII.

attributes.name: magnitude
attributes.documentation: Tsunami magnitude in the Tsunami Magnitude Scale (Mt).  Is greater than zero.

classes.name: VolcanicAshCloud
classes.documentation: An ash cloud formed as a result of a volcanic eruption.

attributes.name: density
attributes.documentation: Particulate density of the ash cloud during the time interval.

attributes.name: particleSize
attributes.documentation: The diameter of the particles during the time interval.

classes.name: Whirlpool
classes.documentation: A whirlpool, a rapidly rotating mass of water in a river or sea into which objects may be drawn, typically caused by the meeting of conflicting currents.

classes.name: RelativeDisplacement
classes.documentation: Vertical displacement relative to either sealevel, ground or the center of the earth.

classes.name: AtmosphericAnalogKind
classes.documentation: Kinds of analogs (floats)  measuring an atmospheric condition.

literals.name: ambientTemperature
literals.documentation: The temperature measured b<font color="#0f0f0f">y a thermometer exposed to the air in a place sheltered from direct solar radiation. </font>Also known as "dry bulb" because<font color="#0f0f0f"> the air temperature is indicated by a thermometer not affecte</font>d by the moisture of the air.

literals.name: dewPoint
literals.documentation: The temperature to which air must be cooled at constant pressure and constant water-vapor content in order for saturation to occur. In other words, it is the temperature at which water vapor starts to condense out of the air.

literals.name: heatIndex
literals.documentation: The temperature of how hot it "feels like" for a given combination of warm air temperature and relative humidity.

literals.name: snow
literals.documentation: Snow amount over a specified period of time.

literals.name: windChill
literals.documentation: The temperature of how cold it "feels like" based on the rate of heat loss from exposed skin caused by the effects of wind and cold temperatures.

literals.name: windSpeedGust
literals.documentation:
Maximum instantaneous wind speed in the 10 minute period preceding a moment in time so long as more than 10 knots of difference has been exhibited between peaks and lulls during that 10 minute time period. 
0 value means no gusts during preceding 10 minute period.

literals.name: windSpeedInstantaneous
literals.documentation: Wind speed at a moment in time.

literals.name: windSpeedPeak
literals.documentation:
Peak instantaneous wind speed in the 60 minutes preceding a moment in time as long as peak speed greater than 25 knots.  
0 value means speed did not exceed 25 knots during preceding 60 minutes.

literals.name: windSpeedSustained
literals.documentation: Average instantaneous wind speed over the 2-minute time period preceding a moment in time.

classes.name: CloudKind
classes.documentation: Kind of cloud.

classes.name: CoverageCodeKind
classes.documentation: Kinds of weather condition coverage.

classes.name: EnvironmentalDiscreteKind
classes.documentation: Discrete (integer) measuring an environmental condition.

classes.name: FScale
classes.documentation:
Fujita scale (referred to as EF-scale starting in 2007) for tornado damage.  A set of wind estimates (not measurements) based on damage. It uses three-second gusts estimated at the point of damage based on a judgment of 8 levels of damage to 28 indicators. These estimates vary with height and exposure.  
The 3 second gust is not the same wind as in standard surface observations.
Enumerations based on NOAA conventions.

classes.name: GeosphericAnalogKind
classes.documentation: Kinds of analogs (floats) measuring a geospheric condition.

classes.name: HydrosphericAnalogKind
classes.documentation: Kinds of analogs (floats) measuring a hydrospheric condition.

classes.name: IntensityCodeKind
classes.documentation: Kinds of weather condition intensity.

classes.name: LocationKind
classes.documentation: The nature of the location being defined for an environmental entity. Possible values are center, perimeter, primary, secondary.

literals.name: center
literals.documentation: The center of a phenomenon. Will typically be used with a Location with a single PositionPoint instance.

literals.name: extent
literals.documentation: The area or line of a phenomenon, not the center. Will typically be used with a Location with multiple PositionPoint instances.

literals.name: primary
literals.documentation: Primary area to which an environmental alert applies.

literals.name: secondary
literals.documentation: Secondary area to which an environmental alert applies.

classes.name: RelativeDisplacementKind
classes.documentation: The types of relative displacement

classes.name: SpaceAnalogKind
classes.documentation: Kinds of analogs (floats) measuring a space condition.

classes.name: TestKind
classes.documentation: The test applied to determine if the condition is met.

classes.name: TimePeriodUnit
classes.documentation: Units in which reporting frequency is specified.

classes.name: ReportingMethodKind
classes.documentation: Method by which information is gathered from station.

literals.name: queried
literals.documentation: Station must be queried to obtain observations.

literals.name: manual
literals.documentation: Station must be physically visited to gather observations.

classes.name: UncertaintyKind
classes.documentation: The type of uncertainty for a reading.

literals.name: standard
literals.documentation: The value has standard uncertainty consistent with National Weather Service practises given the instrument and manner of observation.

literals.name: unknown
literals.documentation: The process of value calculation or measurement is unknown.

classes.name: WeatherCodeKind
classes.documentation: Kinds of weather conditions.

classes.name: Bearing
classes.documentation: The bearing in degrees (with 360 degrees being True North).  Measured in degrees clockwise from True North.  0 degrees indicates no direction being given.

classes.name: MagneticField
classes.documentation: Magnetic field in nanotesla.

classes.name: ParticulateDensity
classes.documentation: Particulate density as kg/m<sup>3</sup>.

subPackages.name: InfMarketOpCommon
subPackages.documentation:
(2013-10-17) NA Team Review
Use Case: How to show when a SchedulingCoordinator submits on behalf of a MarketParticipant? Association between SchedulingCoordinator and MarketOrganisation.

MarketOperator - could be a role type of SchedulingCoordinator.
SchedulingCoordinator can act on behalf of one ore more MarketParticipants.

classes.name: MarketRoleKind
classes.documentation: Kind of market role an organisation can have. This list is not exhausted, as other roles may exist.

literals.name: BalanceResponsibleParty
literals.documentation: A party that has a contract proving financial security and identifying balance responsibility with the Imbalance Settlement Responsible of the Market Balance Area entitling the party to operate in the market. This is the only role allowing a party to nominate energy on a wholesale level. Additional information: The meaning of the word "balance" in this context signifies that the quantity contracted to provide or to consume shall be equal to the quantity really provided or consumed. Equivalent to "Program responsible party" in the Netherlands. Equivalent to "Balance group manager" in Germany. Equivalent to "market agent" in Spain.

literals.name: BalanceSupplier
literals.documentation: A party that markets the difference between actual metered energy consumption and the energy bought with firm energy contracts by the Party Connected to the Grid. In addition the Balance Supplier markets any difference with the firm energy contract (of the Party Connected to the Grid) and the metered production. Additional information: There is only one Balance Supplier for each Accounting Point.

literals.name: BillingAgent
literals.documentation: The party responsible for invoicing a concerned party.

literals.name: BlockEnergyTrader
literals.documentation: A party that is selling or buying energy on a firm basis (a fixed volume per market time period).

literals.name: CapacityCoordinator
literals.documentation: A party, acting on behalf of the System Operators involved, responsible for establishing a coordinated Offered Capacity and/or Net Transfer Capacity (NTC) and/or Available Transfer Capacity (ATC) between several Market Balance Areas.

literals.name: CapacityTrader
literals.documentation:
A party that has a contract to participate in the Capacity Market to acquire capacity through a Transmission Capacity Allocator.

The capacity may be acquired on behalf of an Interconnection Trade Responsible or for sale on secondary capacity markets.

literals.name: Consumer
literals.documentation: A party that consumes electricity. Additional information: This is a Type of Party Connected to the Grid.

literals.name: ConsumptionResponsibleParty
literals.documentation: A party who can be brought to rights, legally and financially, for any imbalance between enegry nominated and consumed for all associated Accounting Points. Additional information: This is a type of Balance Responsible Party.

literals.name: ControlAreaOperator
literals.documentation:
Responsible for :
1. The coordination of exchange programs between its related Market Balance Areas and for the exchanges between its associated Control Areas.
2. The load frequency control for its own area.
3. The coordination of the correction of time deviations.

literals.name: ControlBlockOperator
literals.documentation:
Responsible for :
1. The coordination of exchanges between its associated Control Blocks and the organisation of the coordination of exchange programs between its related Control Areas.
2. The load frequency control within its own block and ensuring that its Control Areas respect their obligations in respect to load frequency control and time deviation.
3. The organisation of the settlement and/or compensation between its Control Areas.

literals.name: CoordinationCenterOperator
literals.documentation:
Responsible for :
1. The coordination of exchange programs between its related Control Blocks and for the exchanges between its associated Coordination Center Zones.
2. Ensuring that its Control Blocks respect their obligations in respect to load frequency control.
3. Calculating the time deviation in cooperation with the associated coordination centers.
4. Carrying out the settlement and/or compensation between its Control Blocks and against the other Coordination Center Zones.

literals.name: GridAccessProvider
literals.documentation: A party responsible for providing access to the grid through an Accounting Point and its use for energy consumption or production to the Party Connected to the Grid.

literals.name: GridOperator
literals.documentation: A party that operates one or more grids.

literals.name: ImbalanceSettlementResponsible
literals.documentation:
A party that is responsible for settlement of the difference between the contracted quantities and the realised quantities of energy products for the Balance Responsible Parties in a Market Balance Area.
Note:
The Imbalance Settlement Responsible has not the responsibility to invoice. The Imbalance Settlement Responsible may delegate the invoicing responsibility to a more generic role such as a Billing Agent.

literals.name: InterconnectionTradeResponsible
literals.documentation: Is a Balance Responsible Party or depends on one. They are recognized by the Nomination Validator for the nomination of already allocated capacity. Additional information: This is a type of Balance Responsible Party.

literals.name: MarketInformationAggregator
literals.documentation: Market Information Aggregator, A party that provides market related information that has been compiled from the figures supplied by different actors in the market. This information may also be published or distributed for general use. Note: The Market Information Aggregator may receive information from any market participant that is relevant for publication or distribution.

literals.name: MarketOperator
literals.documentation: The unique power exchange of trades for the actual delivery of energy that receives the bids from the Balance Responsible Parties that have a contract to bid. The Market Operator determines the market energy price for the Market Balance Area after applying technical constraints from the System Operator. It may also establish the price for the reconciliation within a Metering Grid Area.

literals.name: MeterAdministrator
literals.documentation: A party responsible for keeping a database of meters.

literals.name: MeterOperator
literals.documentation: A party responsible for installing, maintaining, testing, certifying and decommissioning physical meters.

literals.name: MeteredDataCollector
literals.documentation: A party responsible for meter reading and quality control of the reading.

literals.name: MeteredDataResponsible
literals.documentation: A party responsible for the establishment and validation of metered data based on the collected data received from the Metered Data Collector. The party is responsible for the history of metered data for a Metering Point.

literals.name: MeteredDataAggregator
literals.documentation: A party responsible for the establishment and qualification of metered data from the Metered Data Responsible. This data is aggregated according to a defined set of market rules.

literals.name: MeteringPointAdministrator
literals.documentation: A party responsible for registering the parties linked to the metering points in a Metering Grid Area. They are also responsible for maintaining the Metering Point technical specifications. They are responsible for creating and terminating metering points.

literals.name: MOLResponsible
literals.documentation: Responsible for the management of the available tenders for all Acquiring System Operators to establish the order of the reserve capacity that can be activated.

literals.name: NominationValidator
literals.documentation: Has the responsibility of ensuring that all capacity nominated is within the allowed limits and confirming all valid nominations to all involved parties. They inform the Interconnection Trade Responsible of the maximum nominated capacity allowed. Depending on market rules for a given interconnection the corresponding System Operators may appoint one Nomination Validator.

literals.name: PartyConnectedToTheGrid
literals.documentation: A party that contracts for the right to consume or produce electricity at an Accounting Point.

literals.name: Producer
literals.documentation: A party that produces electricity. Additional information: This is a type of Party Connected to the Grid.

literals.name: ProductionResponsibleParty
literals.documentation: A party who can be brought to rights, legally and financially, for any imbalance between energy nominated and produced for all associated Accounting Points. Additional information: This is a type of Balance Responsible Party.

literals.name: ReconciliationAccountable
literals.documentation: A party that is financially accountable for the reconciled volume of energy products for a profiled Accounting Point.

literals.name: ReconciliationResponsible
literals.documentation:
A party that is responsible for reconciling, within a Metering Grid Area, the volumes used in the imbalance settlement process for profiled Accounting Points and the actual metered quantities.
Note:
The Reconciliation Responsible may delegate the invoicing responsibility to a more generic role such as a Billing Agent.

literals.name: ReserveAllocator
literals.documentation: Informs the market of reserve requirements, receives tenders against the requirements and in compliance with the prequalification criteria, determines what tenders meet requirements and assigns tenders.

literals.name: ResourceProvider
literals.documentation: A role that manages a resource object and provides the schedules for it

literals.name: SchedulingCoordinator
literals.documentation: A party that is responsible for the schedule information and its exchange on behalf of a Balance Responsible Party. For example in the Polish market a Scheduling Coordinator is responsible for information interchange for scheduling and settlement.

literals.name: SystemOperator
literals.documentation: A party that is responsible for a stable power system operation (including the organisation of physical balance) through a transmission grid in a geographical area. The System Operator will also determine and be responsible for cross border capacity and exchanges. If necessary they may reduce allocated capacity to ensure operational stability. Transmission as mentioned above means "the transport of electricity on the extra high or high voltage network with a view to its delivery to final customers or to distributors. Operation of transmission includes as well the tasks of system operation concerning its management of energy flows, reliability of the system and availability of all necessary system services." (definition taken from the ENTSO-E RGCE Operation handbook Glossary). Note: additional obligations may be imposed through local market rules.

literals.name: TradeResponsibleParty
literals.documentation: A party who can be brought to rights, legally and financially, for any imbalance between energy nominated and consumed for all associated Accounting Points. Note: A power exchange without any privileged responsibilities acts as a Trade Responsible Party. Additional information: This is a type of Balance Responsible Party.

literals.name: TransmissionCapacityAllocator
literals.documentation: Manages the allocation of transmission capacity for an Allocated Capacity Area. For explicit auctions: The Transmission Capacity Allocator manages, on behalf of the System Operators, the allocation of available transmission capacity for an Allocated capacity Area. They offer the available transmission capacity to the market, allocates the available transmission capacity to individual Capacity Traders and calculates the billing amount of already allocated capacities to the Capacity Traders.

classes.name: RegisteredControllableLoad
classes.documentation: Temporary holding for load reduction attributes removed from RegisteredLoad. Use for future use case when developing the RegisteredDistributedResource specialized classes.

attributes.name: maxBaseLoad
attributes.documentation: Maximum Base Load (MW), per Participating Load Resource

attributes.name: maxDeploymentTime
attributes.documentation: Maximum Deployment time (seconds)

attributes.name: maxLoadRedTimesPerDay
attributes.documentation: Maximum Number of Daily Load Curtailments

attributes.name: maxLoadReduction
attributes.documentation: maximum load reduction

attributes.name: maxReductionTime
attributes.documentation: Maxiimum Load Reduction Time (min), per Participating Load Resource

attributes.name: maxWeeklyDeployment
attributes.documentation: Maximum weekly deployments

attributes.name: minLoadReduction
attributes.documentation:
Minimum MW for a load reduction (e.g., MW rating of a discrete pump.

subPackages.name: DetailedDiagrams
subPackages.documentation:
[tk, 2011-01-09]
  • I have moved association of SubControlArea from GeneratingUnit to Mkt_GeneratingUnit (that was the only remaining direct one). In particular, you'll have to dig into the new package IEC61970::ControlArea, because some minimum concepts, as required for EMS, are defined there with CIM14+ - see with WG13 how and where to consolidate and avoid repetition. I think that package has been defined to support ENTSO-E, and IEC62325 will probably want to extend some of those classes. - Removed association
  • To follow naming conventions, you'll have to rename all the attributes having unit names in them (e.g. maxMW -> maxP or maxActivePower). - Plan to do
  • There are two classes with the same name: Mkt_Line, in EnergyScheduling and in ReferenceData packages. This is probably consequence of merging 2 models (I suspect the one from EnergyScheduling, with association to TransmissionRightOfWay is obsolete; and Mkt_Line is to be kept). Ensure you consolidate the two into one Mkt_Line. - Removed extra Mkt_Line from EnergyScheduling
  • RegisteredGenerator has 65 own attributes plus 33 inherited from RegisteredResource (not shown) - a bit insane. First compare with attributes defined on IEC61970::Production::GeneratingUnit and then consider grouping attributes that always go together and that are defined in both classes, into various <<Compound>>-s - then you can dicrease the number of attributes by "distributing" them into smaller chunks.
  • LogicalConfiguration and ConfigurationMemeber (and related Configuration, not shown here) sound like a local application configuration, and not the data to be exchanged with the standard CIM. Consider removing those classes, in which case the shadow classes Mkt_ThermalGeneratingUnit and Mkt_CombinedCyclePlant become superfluous and can be removed as well. - Classes are required, will consider renaming to a more appropriate representation.

subPackages.name: InfEnergyScheduling
subPackages.documentation: This package provides the capability to schedule and account for transactions for the exchange of electric power between companies. It includes transations for megawatts which are generated, consumed, lost, passed through, sold and purchased. These classes are used by Accounting and Billing for Energy, Generation Capacity, Transmission, and Ancillary Services.

attributes.name: Description

attributes.name: lowerRegMarginReqt
attributes.documentation: Lower regulating margin requirement in MW, the amount of generation that can be dropped by control in 10 minutes

attributes.name: opReserveReqt
attributes.documentation: Operating reserve requirement in MW, where operating reserve is the generating capability that is fully available within 30 minutes. Operating reserve is composed of primary reserve (t less than 10 min) and secondary reserve (10 less than t less than 30 min).

attributes.name: primaryReserveReqt
attributes.documentation: Primary reserve requirement in MW, where primary reserve is generating capability that is fully available within 10 minutes. Primary reserve is composed of spinning reserve and quick-start reserve.

attributes.name: raiseRegMarginReqt
attributes.documentation: Raise regulating margin requirement in MW, the amount of generation that can be picked up by control in 10 minutes

attributes.name: spinningReserveReqt
attributes.documentation: Spinning reserve requirement in MW, spinning reserve is generating capability that is presently synchronized to the network and is fully available within 10 minutes

A control area may have more than one inadvertent account in order to track inadvertent over one or more specific tie points in addition to the usual overall net inadvertent. Separate accounts would also be used to track designated time periods, such as on-peak and off-peak.

classes.name: GenerationProvider

classes.documentation: A type of agreement that provides the default method by which interchange schedules are to be integrated to obtain hourly MWh schedules for accounting.

attributes.name: defaultIntegrationMethod
attributes.documentation: The default method by which interchange schedules are to be integrated to obtain hourly MWh schedules for accounting. Method #1 is to integrate the instantaneous schedule between the hourly boundaries. Method #2 compensates for any up/down ramping that occurs across the hourly boundary (this is called block accounting).

classes.name: OpenAccessProduct

attributes.name: transmissionProductType
attributes.documentation: Type of the transmission product. This could be a transmission service class (firm, total transmission capability, or non-firm), transmission service period (on-peak, full-period, off-peak), transmission service increments (yearly extended, hourly fixed, monthly sliding, etc.), transmission service type (network, available transmission capability, or point-to-point, or a transmission service window (fixed hourly, sliding weekly, extended monthly, etc.).

classes.name: TransmissionProvider
classes.documentation: Provider of  the transmission capacity (interconnecting wires between Generation and Consumption) required  to fulfill and Energy Transaction's energy exchange. Posts information for transmission paths and AvailableTransmissionCapacities  on a reservation node.  Buys and sells its products and services on the same reservation node.

classes.name: TiePoint
classes.documentation: Site of an interface between interchange areas. The tie point can be a network branch (e.g., transmission line or transformer) or a switching device. For transmission lines, the interchange area boundary is usually at a designated point such as the middle of the line. Line end metering is then corrected for line losses.
